## Checklist
- [ ] Acceptance table links every check to captured evidence
- [ ] Threat model signed off
- [ ] Licence gate, SBOM, secret scan and image scan pass
- [ ] Memory measured for each new compose service
- [ ] Test delta stated against the baseline, with no new skips
- [ ] Migrations listed, including "none" when applicable
- [ ] Tests added for new behaviour, and a regression test for each fix
- [ ] Lint, typecheck and tests pass (evidence in the sprint `evidence/` folder)
- [ ] Docs updated in lockstep (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Strict rules respected (docs/architecture.md, section 2)
- [ ] No secrets in the diff or in logs
- [ ] Live preview still runs, or the deploy step is documented
